newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Feb trade deficit narrows to 332.1 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Feb trade deficit narrows to 332.1 mln Sfr.

text.p: Switzerland's trade deficit narrowed to 332.1 million Swiss francs in February from a revised 645.2 million deficit in January, the Federal Customs Office said.
Note - Original January deficit 686.7 million francs, imports 8,315.0 million and exports 7,628.3 million. Figures exclude precious metals and stones, art and antiques.
Including those items, the February trade balance showed a surplus of 31.5 million on exports of 8,602.6 million and imports of 8,571.1 million.

"In the wake of the weakening of the Swiss franc, prices for imported and exported goods were tangibly above the year-earlier level, even if the mean index overstated export price developments," it said.
"Terms of trade thus improved in favour of Switzerland."
Adjusted for the number of working days, exports grew a nominal 10.8 percent and a real 4.6 percent from February 1996. Imports rose a nominal 14.6 percent and a real 10.2 percent.
